paper_record.title: Light-induced rectified orbital magnetization in electron-hole bilayers
paper_record.abstract: Circularly polarized light can rectify orbital motion into a static magnetization through the inverse Faraday effect (IFE), but in electron-hole bilayers the electron and hole contributions cancel exactly when their properties are equivalent. We show that electron-hole bilayers in transition-metal dichalcogenide platforms avoid this cancellation through effective-mass asymmetry alone, and that the surviving orbital IFE is sensitive to interlayer coupling. In the weak-coupling regime, a two-component Drude description yields an induced magnetization of order one Bohr magneton per carrier for representative terahertz driving. In the strong-coupling regime, where the carriers bind into interlayer excitons, we treat the relative motion using a hydrogenic model with a Rytova-Keldysh interaction and obtain a reduced but finite response. We give closed-form expressions that allow estimates across a broad parameter range and identify where the response is largest.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文提出电子-空穴双层结构在圆偏振光驱动下可产生轨道逆法拉第效应，且该效应源于载流子间的有效质量不对称性。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper demonstrates that electron-hole bilayers can exhibit an orbital inverse Faraday effect under circularly polarized light, driven by effective-mass asymmetry between carriers.

problem.zh: 在电荷补偿的电子-空穴双层系统中，圆偏振光驱动通常会导致电子和空穴的轨道贡献相互抵消，从而无法产生净轨道磁化。
problem.en: In charge-compensated electron-hole bilayers, the orbital contributions from electrons and holes typically cancel out under circularly polarized light, preventing a net magnetization.

approach.zh: 通过建立包含层间库仑拖拽的半经典双组分Drude模型，并结合强耦合下的Rytova-Keldysh势激子模型进行数值模拟与微扰理论分析。
approach.en: The study employs a two-component semiclassical Drude model with interlayer Coulomb drag, complemented by a numerical and perturbative analysis of an excitonic model using the Rytova-Keldysh potential.

main_takeaway.zh: 电子-空穴有效质量的不对称性打破了抵消机制，使得即使在电荷平衡的双层系统中也能产生可观的轨道磁化。
main_takeaway.en: Effective-mass asymmetry between electrons and holes breaks the cancellation, allowing for a finite rectified orbital magnetization even in charge-balanced bilayers.

why_it_matters.zh: 该效应为探测电子-空穴双层系统中的层间耦合、激子动力学及载流子关联提供了一种基于光学的非接触式探测手段。
why_it_matters.en: This effect provides a non-contact, optical probe for investigating interlayer coupling, exciton dynamics, and carrier correlations in electron-hole bilayer systems.

reason.zh: 文章清晰阐明了电子-空穴双层系统中轨道逆法拉第效应的物理起源及不同耦合强度下的响应规律。
reason.en: The paper clearly elucidates the physical origin of the orbital inverse Faraday effect in electron-hole bilayers and its response across different coupling regimes.

reason.zh: 该研究属于凝聚态物理中关于光与物质相互作用及低维材料动力学的理论工作，符合PRB的发表范畴。
reason.en: The research focuses on light-matter interaction and dynamics in low-dimensional materials, which is well-aligned with the scope of Physical Review B.
